name: varg-character-keynote
description: Makes a vertical 9:16 "character on stage" video in one varg render: a custom character (Higgsfield Soul) stands at a conference keynote and delivers a one- or two-line hook with a physical punchline, voiced by Seedance 2.5 native audio with audience applause. Use when someone asks for a keynote or speaker-style UGC ad, a talking character or talking avatar giving a speech on stage, a spokesperson or mascot delivering one punchy line, a conference talk clip with a custom person, or wants to swap the character in this template. Not for long talking-head videos from a script or voiceover (use varg-ai with a lip-sync model), multi-scene ads with the same actors (use varg-consistent-characters), two-person dialogue (use varg-podcast-video), or songs (use varg-music-video).
